content: ROADMAP.md contains durable product milestones only and must not link to session context or approval-state planning details.
Lexical JSON fixtures use .txt inputs because Prettier normalizes .json numeric spellings and would invalidate token-preservation cases.
Pi auto-discovers every root-level .ts/.js file in extensions/, so custom-footer support modules and tests belong in a nested directory without an index.ts.
Planning advances immediately after recording a user decision to the next unblocked user decision, or summarizes the frontier and asks to begin execution when none remain.
Planning has explicit discovery-to-delivery-planning and delivery-planning-to-implementation handoffs, with authorized transitions proceeding without idle stops.
Custom Stats Footer keeps its ResponseTpsMeter, quota polling, and UI state inside each extension factory and skips all footer lifecycle/metric work when ctx.hasUI is false.
Subagent workstreams use a disposable 80ms braille-spinner widget that animates only running rows and clears its interval on disposal.
Subagent workstreams animate only running rows with the 35-frame supplied braille spinner at 80ms; paused and inbox rows remain static.
Tests with top-level side effects must live outside direct `extensions/*.ts` discovery because SDK worker resource reload imports each direct extension file in-process.
Interrupted subagent_wait returns a terminating non-error confirmation, and inbox-pending workstream rows lead with `Queued · <worker type> · <purpose>` instead of an opaque ID.
Pi-tools settings definitions can provide an optional detailPreview factory that owns updateValue/dispose lifecycle within only that extension’s SettingsList detail screen.
Extension settings definitions may supply a disposable detailPreview factory; `/pi-tools` renders it only in that extension's detail screen, updates it on field changes, and disposes it on exit.
The research skill stores notes and its index in tmp/research by default, honoring a user-specified destination instead.
Subagent workstream widget refreshes use a monotonic version so older asynchronous inbox/manifests reads cannot restore rows after acknowledgement clears them.
ManagedLspProvisioner cancellation belongs only to the caller that creates a catalog install; joined callers may cancel their own wait without aborting shared provisioning.
Pi extension factories may register tools but must defer getActiveTools/setActiveTools to session_start or later because action methods are unavailable while factories load.
LSP initialize capabilities must include textDocument.publishDiagnostics: {} for TypeScript Language Server 5.3.0 to enable push diagnostics; omitting it makes clean TypeScript inspections time out.

Subagent live workstream tails render contextual labels for read/write/edit paths and bash snippets within 180 safe characters, retain non-empty reasoning summaries, and remove completed reasoning spans with no non-whitespace delta.

Subagent reasoning summaries accumulate stream chunks within each reasoning block, split only on Pi whitespace newline boundary deltas, then render normalized plain-text parts joined by ` · ` with presentation bold delimiters removed.
The Subagent workstreams widget renders completed thinking and successful tool events with `✓`, active events with the spinner, and failed tools with `!`.

Subagent live reasoning tails join whitespace-delimited OpenAI summary parts as plain text with ` · ` separators, suppress Markdown bold delimiters, remove completed empty spans, and mark completed non-empty thinking rows with ✓.
Implicit subagent_wait snapshots must re-read manifest and inbox after liveness checks so a worker settling during snapshot collection is retained rather than lost behind another running worker.
LspClient marks pending dynamic-registration and push-diagnostic waiters unavailable("broken") immediately when its process or protocol connection breaks.
LspClient treats server response errors as per-request unavailable outcomes with bounded detail; only transport, process, or protocol failures mark the client broken.
For the browser tooling initiative, continue through remaining unblocked work without repeatedly asking to proceed, and do not raise cutover until its prerequisites are complete.
Staged browser tool registration must pass the calling Pi session owner to ManagedSessions operations and authorize diagnostic targets before access.
